function SmallestNonNeg(a, b: integer): integer;
begin
  if (a < 0) and (b < 0) then
    Result := -1
  else if a < 0 then
    Result := b
  else if b < 0 then
    Result := a
  else if a < b then
    Result := a
  else
    Result := b;
end;
